notes.title: Welcome to the terrifying world of ALL-NIGHTERS!!!
notes.content:
This update supports multiple languages ​​(English, Simplified Chinese)!!!
Change the language from [Settings] > [Screen Language Settings]!

This update includes the following bug fixes and specification changes.
- Fixed an issue in Chapters 2 and 3 where companions would be unable to pass depending on the opening and closing status of the shutters.
- Changed the trajectory of the strobe light ball so that a message is displayed if it is impossible to reach.
- Changed the location where the breakers appear so that they can be seen from a distance.
- Other minor fixes and specification changes.

notes.title: Hotfix ver2.0.0.7
notes.content:
The following bugs and defects have been fixed.
[list]
[*] In the final chapter, the enemy becomes invisible and stops moving.
[*]Problem that the rotation of ladders and screens does not stop even if they are lifted up again.
[/list]
I made some other fixes.

In addition, we have improved the functionality as follows.
[list]
[*]Adjusted enemy SE.
[*] Added guidance elements.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix ver2.0.0.6
notes.content:
The following bugs and defects have been fixed.
[list]
[*] Issue where footsteps continue to play during the ending movie of Chapter 4
[*]An issue where the enemy's "???" voice sometimes keeps playing in the basement.
[*] Problem where you can go up and down the elevator without being on it.
[*] Problem with sinking when you make your companion wait while riding the elevator.
[/list]
I made some other fixes.

In addition, we have improved the functionality as follows.
[list]
[*]Shutters have been installed at all entrances and exits of the elevator hall.
[*]The length of the hanging knife trap rope has been slightly shortened.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix ver2.0.0.5
notes.content:
The following bugs and defects have been fixed.
[list]
[*] Vitality does not recover when entering a locker while running.
[*] An issue where companions cannot track the player in some old houses in Chapter 4.
[/list]

In addition, we have improved the functionality as follows.
[list]
[*]Specifications have been changed so that players can "pass through" their companions. You no longer have to worry about your companion blocking your path.
[*] Merry will no longer respawn after being defeated. In other words, once Merry is defeated, she will not be revived.
[*]Improved the problem where it was difficult to see in front of the screen.
[*]Changed the spawn location of the code notification to a location that is easier to reach.
[*]We have expanded the irradiation range of some companions' handy lights.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix ver2.0.0.4
notes.content:
The following bugs and defects have been fixed.
[list]
[*] Problem with the world not being paused during the movie.
[*]Some issues that cannot be pressed when the accompanying person is able to speak.
[/list]
Fixed some other bugs.

In addition, we have improved the functionality as follows.
[list]
[*]The difficulty level has been adjusted to make it easier for beginners.
[*]Additional guidance objects have been added.
[*]The guidebook (hints) and guidance explanations have been further enhanced.
[/list]
We've made some other improvements.

notes.title: Hotfix ver2.0.0.3
notes.content:
The following bugs and defects have been fixed.
[list]
[*]Problem that some companions cannot be pressed
[/list]

In addition, we have improved the functionality as follows.
[list]
[*] Added notes about basement structure to basement
[*] Strengthen the power of the hammer to twice the previous one
[*] Guidance objects placed in various locations
[/list]

notes.title: ホットフィックス ver2.0.0.2
notes.content:
以下のバグ・不具合を修正しました。
[list]
[*]第4章「廃れた村伝承」にてクリア分岐ムービーが分岐しない問題
[*]狙撃手にハンマーによる攻撃が当たりづらい問題
[/list]

notes.title: パッチ配信 ver1.0.2.7
notes.content:
[b]パッチノート ver1.0.2.7[/b]
以下の通りで調整および修正を行いました。

- 同行者の指示可能範囲を拡大しました。
- 同行者が「はなす」状態のとき、指示が通らない仕様を調整し、指示が通るようになりました。
|-また，「はなす」状態のとき，追従の指示中でもその場に止まってしまう仕様を調整し、止まらないようになりました。

- 一定の条件で同行者が重複して出現する不具合を修正。
- その他、軽微な調整および修正。

notes.title: パッチ配信 ver1.0.2.6
notes.content:
[b]パッチノート ver1.0.2.6[/b]
以下の通りで調整および修正を行いました。

- ハンディライトの照射範囲を拡大しました。
- タイトル画面で設定内容がリアルタイムに反映されるようになりました。
- チャプター2以降にて、プレイヤー発見時の画面揺れエフェクト時間を短縮しました。
- ゲームオーバー時の一部効果音を変更しました。
- 地下室で固定出現していたスライドドアが一部ランダムスポーンに変更となりました。
- 探索のサポートとして、チャプター2・３で難易度「初心者」「準学士号」を選択した場合、ロビーにて霊感ストロボが支給されるようになりました。

- アイテムチュートリアル中に一時停止されない仕様を修正。
- 同行者と会話中に敵が動いてしまう仕様を修正。
- 敵がオブジェクトの上にスポーンするバグを修正。
- 明るさの設定が保持されないバグを修正。
- その他、軽微な調整および修正。
